h1: Get found. In Google and in AI answers.
lead: We combine classic SEO with GEO, optimisation for AI assistants. Technology, content and mentions work together.

facts.who: SMEs that want to be found locally or nationally

timeline: Audit in 10 working days, results usually after 3–6 months
problem: If you are on page two or missing from AI answers, you don't get enquiries. Clear content and structured data are often what's lacking.
deliverables: Audit with prioritised list of measures
Monthly report on rankings and AI mentions

process.d: Measure technical state, content and AI visibility.
Test the same questions every month.

faq.a: Generative Engine Optimisation: preparing content so that AI assistants can find, understand and cite it.
No, nobody can honestly do that. We work towards measurable goals and show progress openly.

faq.q: How long until the first results?
faq.a: Technical improvements often take effect within weeks. For rankings and AI mentions, expect 3 to 6 months.
